# WPZOOM: Premium WordPress Themes, WordPress Video Theme, Magazine WordPress Themes

> WordPress themes with modern features and professional support\. Responsive themes for photographers, business, ecommerce, video, artists, blogs\.

Generated by Yoast SEO v28.8, this is an llms.txt file, meant for consumption by LLMs.

## Pages
- [WPZOOM Portfolio PRO](https://www.wpzoom.com/plugins/portfolio-pro/): WPZOOM Portfolio PRO is the ultimate WordPress portfolio plugin for creatives, photographers, and video professionals looking to showcase their work elegantly and fully customizable\. Get started today and take your portfolio to the next level\!
- [AI at WPZOOM](https://www.wpzoom.com/ai/)
- [Works with AI Connect](https://www.wpzoom.com/ai-connect/works-with/)
- [What you can do with AI Connect](https://www.wpzoom.com/ai-connect/use-cases/)

## Posts
- [What Is a WordPress Theme? Beginner’s Complete Guide](https://www.wpzoom.com/blog/what-is-wordpress-theme/)
- [How to Start a Food Blog: A Step\-by\-Step Guide](https://www.wpzoom.com/blog/how-to-start-food-blog/): Learn how to start a food blog from scratch with our comprehensive guide\. Discover tips, tools, and strategies to create a successful blog\.
- [The Best WordPress Plugins Every Site Needs](https://www.wpzoom.com/blog/best-wordpress-plugins/): Find out our top picks for the best WordPress plugins \(free and premium\) \- including plugins for SEO, contact forms, recipes, and more\.
- [What's New in Inspiro Premium: Nine Starter Sites, Modal Projects and New Video Widgets](https://www.wpzoom.com/blog/whats-new-inspiro-premium-9-8/): Nine updates since September: nine new starter sites, projects that open like a lightbox page, Portfolio Index, Portfolio Panes and Video Text widgets, a faster theme and a reworked header\.
- [Social Icons Widget 5\.0 Released](https://www.wpzoom.com/blog/social-icons-widget-50/): Social Icons Widget 5\.0 and Social Icons Widget PRO 3\.0 are out under a new name, WPZOOM Connect\. Icons are now inline SVG instead of icon fonts, there are 2,400\+ icons to pick from, a new Social Profiles block, a Google Preferred Sources button, a redesigned dashboard and settings, and a brand\-new demo site\.

    (function() {
        'use strict';

        // Only run once - check if already initialized
        if (window.wpzSafariDownloadHandlerInitialized) {
            return;
        }
        window.wpzSafariDownloadHandlerInitialized = true;

        // Safari detection and download handling
        const isSafari = /^((?!chrome|android).)*safari/i.test(navigator.userAgent);

        if (isSafari) {
            // Wait for DOM to be ready
            function initSafariNotices() {
                // Add Safari notice to pricing tables with download buttons
                const selectors = [
                    '.purchase-button-wrapper a',
                    '.purchase-button a',
                    '.pricing-box-button a',
                    '.pricing_footer_plan a',
                    '.edd-submit',
                    '.buy_main',
                    '.btn.btn-small'
                ];

                selectors.forEach(selector => {
                    const buttons = document.querySelectorAll(selector);
                    buttons.forEach(button => {
                        const text = button.textContent.toLowerCase();
                        // Only add notice to actual download buttons, not purchase buttons
                        if (text.includes('download') && !text.includes('buy') && !text.includes('get ')) {
                            const wrapper = button.closest('.purchase-button-wrapper, .purchase-button, .pricing-box-button, .pricing-box, .pricing_footer_plan');
                            if (wrapper && !wrapper.querySelector('.wpz-safari-pricing-notice')) {
                                const notice = document.createElement('div');
                                notice.className = 'wpz-safari-pricing-notice';
                                notice.style.cssText = 'font-size: 11px; color: #856404; margin-top: 8px; text-align: center;';
                                notice.innerHTML = '';
                                wrapper.appendChild(notice);
                            }
                        }
                    });
                });
            }

            // Initialize notices when DOM is ready
            if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
                document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initSafariNotices);
            } else {
                initSafariNotices();
            }

            // Enhanced download handling for Safari - single event listener
            document.addEventListener('click', function safariDownloadHandler(e) {
                // Helper function to detect EDD download links
                function isEddDownloadLink(element) {
                    // Check if it's an EDD purchase link that shows "Download" text
                    if (element.tagName === 'A') {
                        const text = element.textContent.toLowerCase();
                        const hasDownloadText = text.includes('download');
                        const isEddButton = element.classList.contains('edd-submit') ||
                                          element.classList.contains('buy_main') ||
                                          element.classList.contains('btn') ||
                                          element.closest('.purchase-button-wrapper, .purchase-button, .pricing-box-button, .pricing_footer_plan');

                        // Make sure it's actually a download link (not a purchase link)
                        if (hasDownloadText && !text.includes('buy') && !text.includes('get ')) {
                            return true;
                        }
                    }
                    return false;
                }

                // Target both our custom class and EDD's download links in pricing tables
                if (!e.target.matches('.wpz-download-zip') && !isEddDownloadLink(e.target)) {
                    return;
                }

                // If Option key is held, let default behavior happen
                if (e.altKey) {
                    return;
                }

                // For non-Safari or if auto-disabled due to failures
                const autoDisabled = localStorage.getItem('wpz_enhanced_download_disabled') === 'true';
                if (!isSafari || autoDisabled) {
                    return; // Let the normal download happen
                }

                e.preventDefault();

                const downloadUrl = e.target.href;
                const linkElement = e.target;

                // Try the enhanced download with safety checks
                const downloadStartTime = Date.now();
                const maxFileSize = 100 * 1024 * 1024; // 100MB limit for safety

                // Create a timeout promise
                const timeoutPromise = new Promise((_, reject) => {
                    setTimeout(() => reject(new Error('Download timeout')), 30000); // 30 second timeout
                });

                // Show loading state
                const originalText = linkElement.textContent;
                linkElement.textContent = 'Preparing download...';
                linkElement.style.opacity = '0.6';

                // Race between fetch and timeout
                Promise.race([
                    fetch(downloadUrl, {
                        method: 'GET',
                        credentials: 'same-origin' // Include cookies for authentication
                    }),
                    timeoutPromise
                ])
                .then(response => {
                    if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Download failed: ' + response.status);

                    // Check file size if available
                    const contentLength = response.headers.get('Content-Length');
                    if (contentLength && parseInt(contentLength) > maxFileSize) {
                        throw new Error('File too large for enhanced download');
                    }

                    // Extract filename from Content-Disposition header if available
                    let filename = 'download.zip';
                    const contentDisposition = response.headers.get('Content-Disposition');
                    if (contentDisposition) {
                        const filenameMatch = contentDisposition.match(/filename[^;=\n]*=((['"]).*?\2|[^;\n]*)/);
                        if (filenameMatch && filenameMatch[1]) {
                            filename = filenameMatch[1].replace(/['"]/g, '');
                        }
                    }

                    // Ensure it has .zip extension
                    if (!filename.toLowerCase().endsWith('.zip')) {
                        filename += '.zip';
                    }

                    linkElement.textContent = 'Downloading...';
                    return response.blob().then(blob => ({ blob, filename }));
                })
                .then(({ blob, filename }) => {
                    // Check if download took too long (might indicate issues)
                    if (Date.now() - downloadStartTime > 25000) {
                        throw new Error('Download took too long');
                    }

                    // Create a blob URL and trigger download
                    const blobUrl = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
                    const a = document.createElement('a');
                    a.href = blobUrl;
                    a.download = filename;
                    a.style.display = 'none';
                    document.body.appendChild(a);

                    // Use a try-catch for the click in case it's blocked
                    try {
                        a.click();
                    } catch (clickError) {
                        console.error('Click blocked:', clickError);
                        throw new Error('Download blocked by browser');
                    }

                    // Cleanup
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        document.body.removeChild(a);
                        window.URL.revokeObjectURL(blobUrl);
                    }, 100);

                    // Restore button state
                    linkElement.textContent = originalText;
                    linkElement.style.opacity = '';
                })
                .catch(error => {
                    console.warn('Enhanced download failed:', error.message);

                    // Auto-disable if it consistently fails
                    if (error.message.includes('blocked') || error.message.includes('timeout') || error.message.includes('Download failed')) {
                        localStorage.setItem('wpz_enhanced_download_disabled', 'true');
                        // Re-enable after 24 hours
                        setTimeout(() => {
                            localStorage.removeItem('wpz_enhanced_download_disabled');
                        }, 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
                    }

                    // Fallback to normal download
                    linkElement.textContent = originalText;
                    linkElement.style.opacity = '';

                    // Use standard download as fallback
                    window.location.href = downloadUrl;
                });
            }, true); // Use capture phase to ensure we catch the event early
        }
    })();

        const isSafari = /^((?!chrome|android).)*safari/i.test(navigator.userAgent);

        if (isSafari) {
            // Wait for DOM to be ready
            function initSafariNotices() {
                // Add Safari notice to pricing tables with download buttons
                const selectors = [
                    '.purchase-button-wrapper a',
                    '.purchase-button a',
                    '.pricing-box-button a',
                    '.pricing_footer_plan a',
                    '.edd-submit',
                    '.buy_main',
                    '.btn.btn-small'
                ];

                selectors.forEach(selector => {
                    const buttons = document.querySelectorAll(selector);
                    buttons.forEach(button => {
                        const text = button.textContent.toLowerCase();
                        // Only add notice to actual download buttons, not purchase buttons
                        if (text.includes('download') && !text.includes('buy') && !text.includes('get ')) {
                            const wrapper = button.closest('.purchase-button-wrapper, .purchase-button, .pricing-box-button, .pricing-box, .pricing_footer_plan');
                            if (wrapper && !wrapper.querySelector('.wpz-safari-pricing-notice')) {
                                const notice = document.createElement('div');
                                notice.className = 'wpz-safari-pricing-notice';
                                notice.style.cssText = 'font-size: 11px; color: #856404; margin-top: 8px; text-align: center;';
                                notice.innerHTML = '';
                                wrapper.appendChild(notice);
                            }
                        }
                    });
                });
            }

            // Initialize notices when DOM is ready
            if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
                document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initSafariNotices);
            } else {
                initSafariNotices();
            }

            document.addEventListener('click', function safariDownloadHandler(e) {
                // Helper function to detect EDD download links
                function isEddDownloadLink(element) {
                    // Check if it's an EDD purchase link that shows "Download" text
                    if (element.tagName === 'A') {
                        const text = element.textContent.toLowerCase();
                        const hasDownloadText = text.includes('download');
                        const isEddButton = element.classList.contains('edd-submit') ||
                                          element.classList.contains('buy_main') ||
                                          element.classList.contains('btn') ||
                                          element.closest('.purchase-button-wrapper, .purchase-button, .pricing-box-button, .pricing_footer_plan');

                        // Make sure it's actually a download link (not a purchase link)
                        if (hasDownloadText && !text.includes('buy') && !text.includes('get ')) {
                            return true;
                        }
                    }
                    return false;
                }

                // Target both our custom class and EDD's download links in pricing tables
                if (!e.target.matches('.wpz-download-zip') && !isEddDownloadLink(e.target)) {
                    return;
                }

                // If Option key is held, let default behavior happen
                if (e.altKey) {
                    return;
                }

                // For non-Safari or if auto-disabled due to failures
                const autoDisabled = localStorage.getItem('wpz_enhanced_download_disabled') === 'true';
                if (!isSafari || autoDisabled) {
                    return; // Let the normal download happen
                }

                e.preventDefault();

                const downloadUrl = e.target.href;
                const linkElement = e.target;

                // Try the enhanced download with safety checks
                const downloadStartTime = Date.now();
                const maxFileSize = 100 * 1024 * 1024; // 100MB limit for safety

                // Create a timeout promise
                const timeoutPromise = new Promise((_, reject) => {
                    setTimeout(() => reject(new Error('Download timeout')), 30000); // 30 second timeout
                });

                // Show loading state
                const originalText = linkElement.textContent;
                linkElement.textContent = 'Preparing download...';
                linkElement.style.opacity = '0.6';

                // Race between fetch and timeout
                Promise.race([
                    fetch(downloadUrl, {
                        method: 'GET',
                        credentials: 'same-origin' // Include cookies for authentication
                    }),
                    timeoutPromise
                ])
                .then(response => {
                    if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Download failed: ' + response.status);

                    // Check file size if available
                    const contentLength = response.headers.get('Content-Length');
                    if (contentLength && parseInt(contentLength) > maxFileSize) {
                        throw new Error('File too large for enhanced download');
                    }

                    // Extract filename from Content-Disposition header if available
                    let filename = 'download.zip';
                    const contentDisposition = response.headers.get('Content-Disposition');
                    if (contentDisposition) {
                        const filenameMatch = contentDisposition.match(/filename[^;=\n]*=((['"]).*?\2|[^;\n]*)/);
                        if (filenameMatch && filenameMatch[1]) {
                            filename = filenameMatch[1].replace(/['"]/g, '');
                        }
                    }

                    // Ensure it has .zip extension
                    if (!filename.toLowerCase().endsWith('.zip')) {
                        filename += '.zip';
                    }

                    linkElement.textContent = 'Downloading...';
                    return response.blob().then(blob => ({ blob, filename }));
                })
                .then(({ blob, filename }) => {
                    // Check if download took too long (might indicate issues)
                    if (Date.now() - downloadStartTime > 25000) {
                        throw new Error('Download took too long');
                    }

                    // Create a blob URL and trigger download
                    const blobUrl = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
                    const a = document.createElement('a');
                    a.href = blobUrl;
                    a.download = filename;
                    a.style.display = 'none';
                    document.body.appendChild(a);

                    // Use a try-catch for the click in case it's blocked
                    try {
                        a.click();
                    } catch (clickError) {
                        console.error('Click blocked:', clickError);

                        document.body.removeChild(a);

                    linkElement.style.opacity = '';

                    console.warn('Enhanced download failed:', error.message);

                    // Auto-disable if it consistently fails
                    if (error.message.includes('blocked') || error.message.includes('timeout') || error.message.includes('Download failed')) {

                        }, 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);

                    // Fallback to normal download
                    linkElement.textContent = originalText;
                    linkElement.style.opacity = '';

                    // Use standard download as fallback
                    window.location.href = downloadUrl;
                });
            }, true); // Use capture phase to ensure we catch the event early

    (function() {
        'use strict';

        // Only run once - check if already initialized
        if (window.wpzSafariDownloadHandlerInitialized) {
            return;
        }
        window.wpzSafariDownloadHandlerInitialized = true;

        // Safari detection and download handling
        const isSafari = /^((?!chrome|android).)*safari/i.test(navigator.userAgent);

        if (isSafari) {
            // Wait for DOM to be ready
            function initSafariNotices() {
                // Add Safari notice to pricing tables with download buttons
                const selectors = [
                    '.purchase-button-wrapper a',
                    '.purchase-button a',
                    '.pricing-box-button a',
                    '.pricing_footer_plan a',
                    '.edd-submit',
                    '.buy_main',
                    '.btn.btn-small'
                ];

                selectors.forEach(selector => {
                    const buttons = document.querySelectorAll(selector);
                    buttons.forEach(button => {
                        const text = button.textContent.toLowerCase();
                        // Only add notice to actual download buttons, not purchase buttons
                        if (text.includes('download') && !text.includes('buy') && !text.includes('get ')) {
                            const wrapper = button.closest('.purchase-button-wrapper, .purchase-button, .pricing-box-button, .pricing-box, .pricing_footer_plan');
                            if (wrapper && !wrapper.querySelector('.wpz-safari-pricing-notice')) {
                                const notice = document.createElement('div');
                                notice.className = 'wpz-safari-pricing-notice';
                                notice.style.cssText = 'font-size: 11px; color: #856404; margin-top: 8px; text-align: center;';
                                notice.innerHTML = '';
                                wrapper.appendChild(notice);
                            }
                        }
                    });
                });
            }

            // Initialize notices when DOM is ready
            if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
                document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initSafariNotices);
            } else {
                initSafariNotices();
            }

            // Enhanced download handling for Safari - single event listener
            document.addEventListener('click', function safariDownloadHandler(e) {
                // Helper function to detect EDD download links
                function isEddDownloadLink(element) {
                    // Check if it's an EDD purchase link that shows "Download" text
                    if (element.tagName === 'A') {
                        const text = element.textContent.toLowerCase();
                        const hasDownloadText = text.includes('download');
                        const isEddButton = element.classList.contains('edd-submit') ||
                                          element.classList.contains('buy_main') ||
                                          element.classList.contains('btn') ||
                                          element.closest('.purchase-button-wrapper, .purchase-button, .pricing-box-button, .pricing_footer_plan');

                        // Make sure it's actually a download link (not a purchase link)
                        if (hasDownloadText && !text.includes('buy') && !text.includes('get ')) {
                            return true;
                        }
                    }
                    return false;
                }

                // Target both our custom class and EDD's download links in pricing tables
                if (!e.target.matches('.wpz-download-zip') && !isEddDownloadLink(e.target)) {
                    return;
                }

                // If Option key is held, let default behavior happen
                if (e.altKey) {
                    return;
                }

                // For non-Safari or if auto-disabled due to failures
                const autoDisabled = localStorage.getItem('wpz_enhanced_download_disabled') === 'true';
                if (!isSafari || autoDisabled) {
                    return; // Let the normal download happen
                }

                e.preventDefault();

                const downloadUrl = e.target.href;
                const linkElement = e.target;

                // Try the enhanced download with safety checks
                const downloadStartTime = Date.now();
                const maxFileSize = 100 * 1024 * 1024; // 100MB limit for safety

                // Create a timeout promise
                const timeoutPromise = new Promise((_, reject) => {
                    setTimeout(() => reject(new Error('Download timeout')), 30000); // 30 second timeout
                });

                // Show loading state
                const originalText = linkElement.textContent;
                linkElement.textContent = 'Preparing download...';
                linkElement.style.opacity = '0.6';

                // Race between fetch and timeout
                Promise.race([
                    fetch(downloadUrl, {
                        method: 'GET',
                        credentials: 'same-origin' // Include cookies for authentication
                    }),
                    timeoutPromise
                ])
                .then(response => {
                    if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Download failed: ' + response.status);

                    // Check file size if available
                    const contentLength = response.headers.get('Content-Length');
                    if (contentLength && parseInt(contentLength) > maxFileSize) {
                        throw new Error('File too large for enhanced download');
                    }

                    // Extract filename from Content-Disposition header if available
                    let filename = 'download.zip';
                    const contentDisposition = response.headers.get('Content-Disposition');
                    if (contentDisposition) {
                        const filenameMatch = contentDisposition.match(/filename[^;=\n]*=((['"]).*?\2|[^;\n]*)/);
                        if (filenameMatch && filenameMatch[1]) {
                            filename = filenameMatch[1].replace(/['"]/g, '');
                        }
                    }

                    // Ensure it has .zip extension
                    if (!filename.toLowerCase().endsWith('.zip')) {
                        filename += '.zip';
                    }

                    linkElement.textContent = 'Downloading...';
                    return response.blob().then(blob => ({ blob, filename }));
                })
                .then(({ blob, filename }) => {
                    // Check if download took too long (might indicate issues)
                    if (Date.now() - downloadStartTime > 25000) {
                        throw new Error('Download took too long');
                    }

                    // Create a blob URL and trigger download
                    const blobUrl = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
                    const a = document.createElement('a');
                    a.href = blobUrl;
                    a.download = filename;
                    a.style.display = 'none';
                    document.body.appendChild(a);

                    // Use a try-catch for the click in case it's blocked
                    try {
                        a.click();
                    } catch (clickError) {
                        console.error('Click blocked:', clickError);
                        throw new Error('Download blocked by browser');
                    }

                    // Cleanup
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        document.body.removeChild(a);
                        window.URL.revokeObjectURL(blobUrl);
                    }, 100);

                    // Restore button state
                    linkElement.textContent = originalText;
                    linkElement.style.opacity = '';
                })
                .catch(error => {
                    console.warn('Enhanced download failed:', error.message);

                    // Auto-disable if it consistently fails
                    if (error.message.includes('blocked') || error.message.includes('timeout') || error.message.includes('Download failed')) {
                        localStorage.setItem('wpz_enhanced_download_disabled', 'true');
                        // Re-enable after 24 hours
                        setTimeout(() => {
                            localStorage.removeItem('wpz_enhanced_download_disabled');
                        }, 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
                    }

                    // Fallback to normal download
                    linkElement.textContent = originalText;
                    linkElement.style.opacity = '';

                    // Use standard download as fallback
                    window.location.href = downloadUrl;
                });
            }, true); // Use capture phase to ensure we catch the event early
        }
    })();

    (function() {
        'use strict';

        // Only run once - check if already initialized
        if (window.wpzSafariDownloadHandlerInitialized) {
            return;
        }
        window.wpzSafariDownloadHandlerInitialized = true;

        // Safari detection and download handling
        const isSafari = /^((?!chrome|android).)*safari/i.test(navigator.userAgent);

        if (isSafari) {
            // Wait for DOM to be ready
            function initSafariNotices() {
                // Add Safari notice to pricing tables with download buttons
                const selectors = [
                    '.purchase-button-wrapper a',
                    '.purchase-button a',
                    '.pricing-box-button a',
                    '.pricing_footer_plan a',
                    '.edd-submit',
                    '.buy_main',
                    '.btn.btn-small'
                ];

                selectors.forEach(selector => {
                    const buttons = document.querySelectorAll(selector);
                    buttons.forEach(button => {
                        const text = button.textContent.toLowerCase();
                        // Only add notice to actual download buttons, not purchase buttons
                        if (text.includes('download') && !text.includes('buy') && !text.includes('get ')) {
                            const wrapper = button.closest('.purchase-button-wrapper, .purchase-button, .pricing-box-button, .pricing-box, .pricing_footer_plan');
                            if (wrapper && !wrapper.querySelector('.wpz-safari-pricing-notice')) {
                                const notice = document.createElement('div');
                                notice.className = 'wpz-safari-pricing-notice';
                                notice.style.cssText = 'font-size: 11px; color: #856404; margin-top: 8px; text-align: center;';
                                notice.innerHTML = '';
                                wrapper.appendChild(notice);
                            }
                        }
                    });
                });
            }

            // Initialize notices when DOM is ready
            if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
                document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initSafariNotices);
            } else {
                initSafariNotices();
            }

            // Enhanced download handling for Safari - single event listener
            document.addEventListener('click', function safariDownloadHandler(e) {
                // Helper function to detect EDD download links
                function isEddDownloadLink(element) {
                    // Check if it's an EDD purchase link that shows "Download" text
                    if (element.tagName === 'A') {
                        const text = element.textContent.toLowerCase();
                        const hasDownloadText = text.includes('download');
                        const isEddButton = element.classList.contains('edd-submit') ||
                                          element.classList.contains('buy_main') ||
                                          element.classList.contains('btn') ||
                                          element.closest('.purchase-button-wrapper, .purchase-button, .pricing-box-button, .pricing_footer_plan');

                        // Make sure it's actually a download link (not a purchase link)
                        if (hasDownloadText && !text.includes('buy') && !text.includes('get ')) {
                            return true;
                        }
                    }
                    return false;
                }

                // Target both our custom class and EDD's download links in pricing tables
                if (!e.target.matches('.wpz-download-zip') && !isEddDownloadLink(e.target)) {
                    return;
                }

                // If Option key is held, let default behavior happen
                if (e.altKey) {
                    return;
                }

                // For non-Safari or if auto-disabled due to failures
                const autoDisabled = localStorage.getItem('wpz_enhanced_download_disabled') === 'true';
                if (!isSafari || autoDisabled) {
                    return; // Let the normal download happen
                }

                e.preventDefault();

                const downloadUrl = e.target.href;
                const linkElement = e.target;

                // Try the enhanced download with safety checks
                const downloadStartTime = Date.now();
                const maxFileSize = 100 * 1024 * 1024; // 100MB limit for safety

                // Create a timeout promise
                const timeoutPromise = new Promise((_, reject) => {
                    setTimeout(() => reject(new Error('Download timeout')), 30000); // 30 second timeout
                });

                // Show loading state
                const originalText = linkElement.textContent;
                linkElement.textContent = 'Preparing download...';
                linkElement.style.opacity = '0.6';

                // Race between fetch and timeout
                Promise.race([
                    fetch(downloadUrl, {
                        method: 'GET',
                        credentials: 'same-origin' // Include cookies for authentication
                    }),
                    timeoutPromise
                ])
                .then(response => {
                    if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Download failed: ' + response.status);

                    // Check file size if available
                    const contentLength = response.headers.get('Content-Length');
                    if (contentLength && parseInt(contentLength) > maxFileSize) {
                        throw new Error('File too large for enhanced download');
                    }

                    // Extract filename from Content-Disposition header if available
                    let filename = 'download.zip';
                    const contentDisposition = response.headers.get('Content-Disposition');
                    if (contentDisposition) {
                        const filenameMatch = contentDisposition.match(/filename[^;=\n]*=((['"]).*?\2|[^;\n]*)/);
                        if (filenameMatch && filenameMatch[1]) {
                            filename = filenameMatch[1].replace(/['"]/g, '');
                        }
                    }

                    // Ensure it has .zip extension
                    if (!filename.toLowerCase().endsWith('.zip')) {
                        filename += '.zip';
                    }

                    linkElement.textContent = 'Downloading...';
                    return response.blob().then(blob => ({ blob, filename }));
                })
                .then(({ blob, filename }) => {
                    // Check if download took too long (might indicate issues)
                    if (Date.now() - downloadStartTime > 25000) {
                        throw new Error('Download took too long');
                    }

                    // Create a blob URL and trigger download
                    const blobUrl = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
                    const a = document.createElement('a');
                    a.href = blobUrl;
                    a.download = filename;
                    a.style.display = 'none';
                    document.body.appendChild(a);

                    // Use a try-catch for the click in case it's blocked
                    try {
                        a.click();
                    } catch (clickError) {
                        console.error('Click blocked:', clickError);
                        throw new Error('Download blocked by browser');
                    }

                    // Cleanup
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        document.body.removeChild(a);
                        window.URL.revokeObjectURL(blobUrl);
                    }, 100);

                    // Restore button state
                    linkElement.textContent = originalText;
                    linkElement.style.opacity = '';
                })
                .catch(error => {
                    console.warn('Enhanced download failed:', error.message);

                    // Auto-disable if it consistently fails
                    if (error.message.includes('blocked') || error.message.includes('timeout') || error.message.includes('Download failed')) {
                        localStorage.setItem('wpz_enhanced_download_disabled', 'true');
                        // Re-enable after 24 hours
                        setTimeout(() => {
                            localStorage.removeItem('wpz_enhanced_download_disabled');
                        }, 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
                    }

                    // Fallback to normal download
                    linkElement.textContent = originalText;
                    linkElement.style.opacity = '';

                    // Use standard download as fallback
                    window.location.href = downloadUrl;
                });
            }, true); // Use capture phase to ensure we catch the event early
        }
    })();
